title: Data scale and index {index}
description: Drag the slider to see the number of levels, the index size and the pages read when table {table} has more rows. This only describes the index structure, it does not predict speed.
noProbe: Not measured: there is no probe query, or the plan has no page count.
cancelled: Cancelled. Your table was not changed and the temporary table was dropped.
scratchNote: Each point is measured on a temporary table with the same columns and randomly generated data. Only the structure of your table is read, nothing is written or deleted, and the temporary table is dropped as soon as the measurement ends. The index in the temporary table is built fresh with CREATE INDEX, so it is more compact than an index that has been written to many times (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE); the measurement may be smaller than your real index.
warn500k: The 500,000-row point needs about 600 MB of RAM and can take from tens of seconds to a few minutes. A machine with little RAM may slow down or freeze the tab.
unmeasuredNow: The {rows, number}-row point is not measured yet. Load the data and measure to get real numbers.
needSample: There is no number at this scale: measure at least one real point to use as the formula sample. Not simulated yet.
estimateFrom: This number comes from a formula applied to a real sample of {rows, number} rows. It was not run.
measuredFrom: Real measurement on {rows, number} rows, using pageinspect.
treeEstimated: The estimated tree only tells you the number of levels. The system does not draw individual nodes because no node was read at this scale.
treeNone: The tree of this point could not be read.
scope: Levels, size and pages only describe the index structure. They are not run time and do not predict production.
tableMissing: Could not measure: this table is not in the public schema. Not simulated yet.
indexMissing: This index does not exist on the table, so there is nothing to measure. Create the index and open this again. Not simulated yet.
notBtree: Could not measure: this index is not a B-Tree. Not simulated yet.
partial: Could not measure: a partial index (with WHERE) makes the numbers wrong because the table row count includes rows that are not in the index. Not simulated yet.
scratchBusy: Could not measure: a temporary table from another measurement exists. Try again when that one finishes.
